journey.body:
Reno Stars was built on experience. Not just in construction but in understanding the renovation industry from both sides.

Before founding Reno Stars in 2020, our team spent years working on renovation platforms, connecting homeowners with contractors. We have seen thousands of projects from start to finish, and more importantly, we have seen where things go wrong.

We understand the common frustrations homeowners face: quotes that grow with hidden items, poor communication and delayed responses, uncertain timelines, and inconsistent workmanship due to unstable crews. These are not rare issues. They are industry norms. That is exactly why Reno Stars was created.

contact.whyChooseRenoStarsP1: With over a decade of hands-on experience in Metro Vancouver, Reno Stars has built a reputation for delivering renovation projects that exceed expectations. Our team of licensed tradespeople, project managers, and designers work together under one roof to ensure every detail — from structural changes to finishing touches — is executed with precision and care. We are fully insured with $5M CGL coverage and maintain active WCB registration for all our workers, so you can have complete peace of mind throughout your project.

q1.answer: Renovation cost in Vancouver depends on project type and tier. Bathroom renovations start at $10K, kitchens at $15K, basements at $30K, and whole-house projects at $50K. The biggest cost drivers are material choice, layout changes (plumbing/electrical relocation), and permit complexity. See the per-project guides for detailed ranges from our 100+ completed Metro Vancouver projects.

index.intro: Real renovation cost data from 100+ completed projects across Metro Vancouver — whole-house renovations run $150–$400/sq ft, kitchens $15K–$72K, bathrooms $10K–$60K. Each guide breaks down pricing by tier, what your budget actually buys, and the most common cost drivers.
